# PromptShield · AI Safety Suite (promptshield) — full text

This file is the "full" edition of the llms.txt standard, for long-context models.

## What this is

`promptshield` (slug: ai-safety-suite) is a *methodology collection* for agent
runtime safety. One install, your agent stops leaking secrets and obeying
injected instructions. It has the same shape as top-of-ecosystem superpowers
collections: one repo, one `SKILL.md` orchestrator, multi-vendor plugin shims,
and a one-page ASCII lifecycle map. Where external collections ship *tools
without governance*, PromptShield ships theory (LGD three laws) + skills +
evidence chain + admission gates as one auditable unit.

## The safety lifecycle (five stages)

1. **RED-TEAM** — `agent-redteam-kit` (confidential, capability name only) and
   `prompt-injection-drill`: attack first so you know what to defend.
2. **SHIELD** — `prompt-injection-shield`: block hostile input at runtime.
3. **LEAK** — `prompt-leak-scanner` and `token-disclosure-check`: find what you
   expose before shipping.
4. **GUARD** — `tool-call-guard`, `agent-loop-guard`, `mcp-security-scan`:
   control what the agent may call (tools / loops / MCP).
5. **GATE** — `skill-admission-gate`: decide what may enter the library.

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield.git
cd promptshield

# the whole lifecycle
python3 scripts/promptshield_flow.py --list

# how to run one stage (e.g. the guard stage)
python3 scripts/promptshield_flow.py --route guard
```

Per-agent install: Claude Code `claude plugin install promptshield@promptshield`;
Codex drop `.codex-plugin/` next to your project; Cursor copy `.cursor-plugin/`.
